reason: Document A is easier to follow. author: haiku
reason: A states plainly where every piece of state lives: the KV key, the per-copy decision records, the archive manifest and seal point, and when the offset is committed. It walks through each crash point in order, so a newcomer can follow what happens and what happens on failure. B leaves gaps and contradictions: it keys the log by device_id while also claiming that guarantees ordering per event_id, it never says when the offset commits, it leaves SETNX failure open, and replay re-derives the winners by a second method.
